verdict.rationale: Repository rulesets can require pull requests, reviews and passing checks, and can block deletion and force pushes. They also offer an evaluate (warn-only) mode and CODEOWNERS approval, and Buildkite results appear as PR checks. That enforces policy per repository. The docs only describe rulesets at repository level, so centrally enforcing standards across all teams and repositories is unevidenced. Missing for 10: organization-wide or cross-repository rulesets, team-scoped policy management, a built-in linting or coding-standards enforcement mechanism, and independent corroboration.
